cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: A flat lesion that differs only in colour is a macule or patch.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: The lecture uses 5 mm to distinguish a vesicle from a bulla.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: A transient raised lesion due to dermal oedema is a wheal.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: Thick skin with accentuated skin markings after repeated rubbing is lichenification.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: Thickening of viable epidermis is acanthosis.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: Retained nuclei in the stratum corneum define parakeratosis.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: Intercellular epidermal oedema is spongiosis.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: Premature keratinisation of individual viable epidermal cells is dyskeratosis.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: Acute eczema can form intraepidermal vesicles through severe spongiosis.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: Chronic eczema has more acanthosis and hyperkeratosis and less spongiosis.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: Allergic contact dermatitis is a delayed type IV hypersensitivity reaction.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: Irritant contact dermatitis results from direct skin injury without prior sensitisation.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: The atopic triad is eczema, asthma and allergic rhinitis.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: Pinpoint bleeding after lifting a psoriasis scale is the Auspitz sign.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: New lesions at sites of skin trauma are the Koebner phenomenon.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: Munro microabscesses contain neutrophils in the stratum corneum.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: Pustules of Kogoj contain neutrophils in the spongiotic viable epidermis.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: A blackhead is an open comedone.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: After a follicle ruptures in acne, neutrophils arrive early and foreign-body granulomas may follow.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: Erythema nodosum is the classic septal panniculitis.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: A biopsy for suspected panniculitis must include subcutaneous fat.

cards.subject: Pathology
cards.search: Lupus panniculitis and pancreatic panniculitis typically show a lobular pattern.
